title: Payment-Method Schedule for Pre-K Tuition Payment Plans
content:
**Schedule.** Under the payment-method schedule of Student Enrollment, Transfers and Pre-Kindergarten Admissions, a family whose Pre-K tuition account shows tuition payments by personal check or money order in the school year has an amount added to the payment plan's down payment:

| Tuition payments by personal check or money order on the enrollment in the school year | Added to the down payment |
|---|---|
| two or more | 20.00 |
| exactly one | 10.00 |
| none | nothing |

Personal checks and money orders are counted together; online card and ACH bank draft payments are not counted.

## Examples (hypothetical enrollments)

- Two money orders this school year: 20.00 added.
- One personal check and several online card payments: 10.00 added.
- No paper payment: nothing added.
